Costume: Narita Brian (Gym uniform)
Doing warm-up exercises or similar
(......Yes, you are strong.)

...So that's Narita Brian.
To possess such presence before even debuting...
...Then fine by me.

Well, sure, it was against a junior, but winning at 2,000 meters
is nothing short of amazing! As expected, you're—

I know her strength better than anyone.
...As well as what she has had to shoulder because of it.

Yes, it is widening.
For an ordinary horse girl, that may well be an insurmountable gap.

I didn't win at all...! A monster like that...!
Someone like me had no business racing her...!

Ah, there you are~! Geez, you can't just go
taking on races without permission!
...I'm... sorry, Trainer.
(......Ahead of me, her hair and tail sway.)

Those rumors were true after all.
About her challenging graded stakes winners to unofficial match races...!

*gasp*... *pant*...
...*wheeze*...

Let's set the race to your preferred distance.
How about 2,000 meters?

She brings despair to all who dare compete against her.
That is Narita Brian... my younger sister.

...I had that dream again. Chasing her back.
A sweet sensation where every stride pounding the turf filled my soul—

Three lengths... two lengths...... No, she's already within striking distance!
Incredible, this is incredible! Brian!!
(*thump, thump, tap... tap... tap...*)

Please, stop. After seeing talent like that,
I don't... want to hear your pity...!
Is that a distance where you can give it your all?

A horse girl rumored among trainers to possess "bottomless potential."
I came all the way here hoping to catch a glimpse of her, but—

...Kh! ...No way... that was totally my pace...!
There's no way... a pre-debut rookie... could catch up to me...!!
“—Come on, Brian!”
Th-Then the one who won was—

Awa-wa-wa-wa... H-Hayahideee~~!!
They've already passed the fourth corner and the gap, the gap is...!

Wh-What is this?! That speed...!
The gap is shrinking so fast...!

(I heard she's a GⅠ-caliber horse girl.
Her strength is no fluke. There's no reason... to hold back!)

(So please, let me keep chasing you like this.
Please don't let me overtake you just yet.)

No, no, no, how can I be calm?!
Her opponent today is an insaaa-aaanely strong horse girl, you know?!
She won't.
Even Brian would be totally crushed if she suffered a crushing defeat, like—

Yes, against you. As your senior, it's only natural I give you a handicap.
It's a non-negotiable condition for me to accept this match.

(Show me your fighting spirit until the very end.
And please—!!)

...Thank you, Ticket. I hear your voice loud and clear.
So please, calm down.

An overwhelming disparity in power. Witnessing something so far
beyond reach up close breeds fear in one's heart, not passion.
(*rumble rumble rumble!*)

...Wait. What's with this mood...?
Why isn't the girl who won happy at all?
(*crunch...*)

(How many times have I watched the light fade right before my eyes?
How many times have I watched them be swallowed by the darkness...)
...If she were an ordinary horse girl, that is.
...Are you coming, Brian?
—It was a fragile dream.

A training track wrapped in palpable excitement.
At its center stood a single horse girl.
(...Is this as far as it goes, again?)

Woaaah~~! Hayahide, over here, over here, over hereee!!
Brian's race is already startingーーー!

My encounter with Narita Brian began
with that strange, unsettling feeling—

Despite the sheer excitement surrounding the race,
Narita Brian's run came to an end in eerie silence.

Something about her run felt deeply off. Not just how her sudden deceleration
cut through that brilliant late surge, but the pained look on her face as well.

...Narita Brian slowed down right before the wire.
Did she run out of stamina at the very end?
